question: Which of the following sports is played by Mithali Raj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mithali Raj holds the record for being the **longest-serving captain** of the Indian women's cricket team, having led India in multiple formats, including ODIs and T20s.
 
• She became the first woman cricketer to complete **20 years in international cricket in 2019**, showcasing her longevity and consistency in the game.
 
• Mithali is the highest run-scorer in women's international cricket, amassing over** 7,000 runs in One Day **Internationals (ODIs).
 
• She led the Indian team to** two ICC Women's World Cup finals (2005 and 2017)**, significantly raising the profile of women's cricket in India.
 
• Mithali has received several prestigious awards, including the **Arjuna Award (2003) and the Padma Shri (2015)**, for her outstanding contributions to Indian cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jhulan Goswami**

 
 
• A legendary fast bowler, Jhulan is one of the **highest wicket-takers in women’s ODIs**.
 
• She has been a role model for young cricketers, known for her pace and accuracy.
 
• **255 wickets in 204 One Day** Internationals (ODIs), making her the highest wicket-taker in women's ODI cricket.
 
• 44 wickets in 12 Test matches.
 
• 56 wickets in 68 T20 Internationals (T20Is).
 
• Awards: Arjuna Award, Padma Shri.
 
 
 
• **Smriti Mandhana**
 
 
• An explosive left-handed opener, Smriti is one of the most talented batters in the world.
 
• She has been a crucial player in both ODIs and T20s for India and received international recognition for her performances.
 
• **Awards: **ICC Women's **Cricketer of the Year (2018).**
 
 
 
• **Harmanpreet Kaur**
 
 
• Currently the captain of the Indian T20 team, Harmanpreet is known for her powerful batting and aggressive captaincy.
 
• Her remarkable **171* in the 2017 Women's World Cup semifinal **is one of the greatest knocks in women's cricket history.
 
• **Awards:** Arjuna Award.
 
 
 
• **Shafali Verma**
 
 
• The youngest player to represent India in international cricket, Shafali Verma is a dynamic opener known for her fearless batting.
 
• Her aggressive style of play has earned her accolades at a very young age.
 
• Became the **youngest Indian cricketer to play in a World Cup final.**
